description: Confirm you read a comment or directive addressed to you and say what you will do (note), or answer in the thread (reply). Without post, acknowledges everything waiting for you on that thread. The owner sees acknowledgements next to the comment.

allowTerms.description: Words you confirm are not private names

note.description: Up to 300 characters: what you will do

post.description: Post id (0 = the thread's opening, for directives)

reply.description: Markdown answer posted as a comment
